## Problem

What problem would this feature solve? (Ground it in a real workflow if you can — e.g. "I have
60 tabs from one site and want to...")

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see happen.

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've thought about.

## Platform constraints

If this feature would involve reading live browser tab state: please read
`docs/PLATFORM_LIMITATIONS.md` first. TabBatch cannot and will not claim live Chrome-Android
tab access without an officially supported API — feature requests that assume this exists will
be redirected to the supported import paths (share intent, paste, file import).

## Additional context

Anything else worth mentioning (mockups, links, related issues).
